sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Neha Khan Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Jitendra Kumar Sinha,J.
1. Heard Ms. Neha Khan, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Krishna Mohan Tiwari, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This writ petition has been filed for the following relief:-
"Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus, commanding and directing the direct the respondent authorities to investigate the aforesaid case being Sagir Ahmad vs State Of Uttar Pradesh And 11 Others on 29 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138639049/
1 Case Crime No.749 of 2024, under Section 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Sadar Bazar, District Shahjahanpur, fairly within a specific period."

entities.text: Sagir Ahmad vs State Of Uttar Pradesh And 11 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3. On being pointed out, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has already approached appropriate court for the purpose of fair investigation and an order dated 07.04.2025 has already been passed by the court below.
4.
He further submits that he may be permitted to withdraw the petition and it may be dismissed as withdrawn.
5. Accordingly, the writ petition stands dismissed as withdrawn.
